sprint: Sprint 3 — Dataset Audit and Exploratory Analysis

primary_dataset_cdc.license: CC0 Public Domain (U.S. Federal Government Open Data)

evaluated_comparison_pima.provenance: National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (NIDDK)
evaluated_comparison_pima.cohort: Pima Native American females aged >= 21 years (Phoenix, Arizona)
evaluated_comparison_pima.missing_value_anomaly: Physiological zeros present in fasting glucose (5 zeros), BP (35 zeros), skinfold (227 zeros), BMI (11 zeros), insulin (374 zeros)
evaluated_comparison_pima.audit_decision: REJECTED for general Indian clinical outpatient screening due to genetic homogeneity and restricted cohort traits.

primary_dataset_cleveland.provenance: Cleveland Clinic Foundation (Dr. Robert Detrano et al., 1988)
primary_dataset_cleveland.cohort: Inpatient cardiology referral patients undergoing coronary angiography
primary_dataset_cleveland.target_definition: Angiographic diameter narrowing >= 50% in at least one major vessel (fluoroscopic ground truth)

evaluated_comparison_framingham.provenance: National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute (NHLBI) & Boston University
evaluated_comparison_framingham.cohort: General community population of Framingham, MA followed prospectively since 1948
evaluated_comparison_framingham.longitudinal_follow_up: 10-year and 30-year prospectively tracked incident MACE endpoints
evaluated_comparison_framingham.data_availability: Restricted access; requires formal BioLINCC data-use agreement and institutional review board approval
evaluated_comparison_framingham.current_platform_use: SwasthyaCare implements published Framingham ASCVD Cox regression coefficients (Sprint 6). De novo ML model training deferred pending raw longitudinal cohort access.

gating_decisions.ML-DIA-01: APPROVED (CDC BRFSS supports cross-sectional diabetes status)
gating_decisions.ML-DIA-02: GATED / DEFERRED (Cross-sectional data cannot model 5-year future risk)
gating_decisions.ML-CVD-01: APPROVED (UCI Cleveland supports angiographic stenosis classification)
gating_decisions.ML-CVD-02: GATED / DEFERRED (Inpatient catheterization data cannot model 10-year prospective MACE)
